ci-bot: nightly-perf-check: regression detected for nightly/bench-smallbatch — p95 increased by 18% vs baseline (2026-03-16)
ci-bot: job: nightly/bench-smallbatch · build 9a1f2e3 · dashboard: https://perf.redwood/reports/2801234567 · trace: https://traces.redwood/9a1f2e3 :rotating_light:
maria: ugh, saw this in my inbox. anyone on-call for runtime perf tonight? @sanjay ?
sanjay: I can take first pass. grabbing perf artifacts now. can someone drop the failing command/run id?
ci-bot: failing run id: run-2026-03-16-03:12 · repro script: https://ci.redwood/jobs/run-2026-03-16-03:12/artefacts/repro.sh
lee: quick note — the change that landed yesterday touching KV cache serialize was in #4321, pinging potential suspect.
katie: assigning @sanjay and @lee to triage. please post a short plan + ETA by +30m
sanjay: plan: 1) run repro locally on 2 configs (with/without kv-serialize) 2) collect p95 breakdown from perf traces 3) if repro, bisect between last-green..HEAD. ETA 45m.
maria: thanks. @opsbot can you snapshot infra metrics for the failing window? cpu/gpu, mem, queue-length?
opsbot: snapshot taken: https://infra.redwood/snapshots/2801234567 · metrics: cpu-gpu: nominal, gpu-util 62%, io-wait small, queue-length spiked ~1.2x at 03:10
sanjay: running repro now. local run shows p95 +22% when kv-serialize enabled, baseline stable without it. attaching snippet:
```
# repro command
./bench_runner --profile smallbatch --model llama-13b --runs 100 --kv-serialize=on
# p95: 124ms (baseline 101ms)
```
lee: that aligns with my quick grep through #4321 — we added an extra memcpy path when serializing the cache to support new layout.
katie: if bisect needed, what range? last-green is build 9a1b1c0, culprit landed in 9a1f2e3 (PR #4321)
sanjay: bisect range: 9a1b1c0..9a1f2e3. I'll start automated bisect now. posting status in ~20m.
maria: if bisect confirms, consider quick revert or micro-optimizing serialization path for next deploy window. keep me posted.
sanjay: automated bisect started: https://ci.redwood/bisect/2801234567 · current candidate failing at commit 9a1f2e3 (prelim). I'll run one more sanity run to confirm.
lee: if confirmed, I can open a follow-up PR to change memcpy -> zero-copy slice for the common path, should be small.
katie: ok thanks. please add a quick benchmark in PR to show p95 impact. looping in release leads if we need a hotfix.
sanjay: update: second run reproduced. marking culprit to PR #4321. filing bisect results and a minimal repro in the bug: https://issues.redwood/INFR-987
maria: perfect. set a postmortem label and schedule a short 15m sync tomorrow morning if we end up rolling back.
ci-bot: note: nightly pipeline will hold further deploys until manual approval after triage (flagged by katie).
